# Parser fixtures

Each `*.vt` file is the raw byte stream that ConPTY emitted while running `claude --ax-screen-reader` (axClaude's fixtures, `*-claude*.vt`) or a shell as axTerminal starts it (`shell-*.vt`, `PtyCapture --shell`), recorded with `tools/PtyCapture`. The files are binary (control bytes, UTF-8 text) and are marked as such in `.gitattributes`. Never edit them by hand: cursor positions inside the stream depend on the exact text lengths.

`*.expected.txt` next to a recording is the transcript the parser must produce for it, as the reader sees it: one logical line per line, chrome lines omitted, and reply rows that Claude hard-wrapped at the console width joined on one line (FR-3.2a). Tests fail when the two disagree.

Naming: `<topic>-claude<version>-<cols>x<rows>.vt` for axClaude's, `shell-<shell><version>-<cols>x<rows>.vt` for axTerminal's (`tests/AxTerminal.Tests/ShellFixtureTests`; `docs/axterminal/SPEC.md`).

Review every recording before committing it: the session header names the account plan and the model, folder paths include the user name, and replies may quote files. Re-record from a neutral scratch folder rather than redacting bytes.

`*.vt.chunks.txt` next to a recording lists the chunk boundaries (`offset length elapsedMs`), so a test can replay a recording chunk by chunk with the app's timing and its `Send` calls: `ReplayTests` (`long-message`, `steering`), `QuestionTests` (`model-picker`, `permission-prompt`, `several-questions`, `other-answer`, `wrapped-answers`) and `FeedbackCardTests` (`feedback-card`). The `background` and `tasks-screen` chunk files are read by no test and stay as provenance.
